# Gillco Meraqui

> Gillco Meraqui is a RERA-approved luxury residential project offering 3+1 and 4 BHK dual-core flats on Airport Road, Sector 126, Mohali.

- [Overview](https://www.gillcomeraqui-mohali.com/gillco-meraqui-overview): Project scale, planning, and residence overview.
- [Floor Plans](https://www.gillcomeraqui-mohali.com/gillco-meraqui-floor-plans): 3+1 and 4 BHK plan library.
- [Price & Cost Sheet](https://www.gillcomeraqui-mohali.com/gillco-meraqui-price): Request current commercial information.
- [Location](https://www.gillcomeraqui-mohali.com/gillco-meraqui-location): Airport Road and Sector 126 context.
- [Contact](https://www.gillcomeraqui-mohali.com/contact-gillco-meraqui): Call, WhatsApp, and project-area map.
- [FAQ](https://www.gillcomeraqui-mohali.com/gillco-meraqui-faq): Buyer questions and verification guidance.

## Important information

- RERA registration reference: PBRERA-SAS81-PR1390-062026.
- Buyers should confirm current specifications, availability, address details, timelines, and commercial terms with official project documentation.
